data.title: bn-1mgcv: workspace.create binds only to the accepted head; a lock successor records the lock itself; RFC 0037 correction 23

data.body: [risk:high] No security finding in 6c13b4f..3f65b2b. Failure modes: absent time, inactive signer, held successor, and malformed lineage all refuse before registry writes. Edge cases: pre-3.8 or keyless locks stay unsigned and peer-unacceptable. Both workspace-create lanes reach workspace.rs:360. Bundle status and successor disagreement fails at intent.rs:776-785. Rollback: revert this target and disable intent.lock plus workspace.create until a replacement ships. Reverting alone restores the two security defects. Monitoring: alert on intent.lock UnsupportedSemanticFeature and workspace.create AcceptanceChainInvalid spikes. Audit accepted records for status and superseded_by agreement. Validation: inspected all eight changed files and traced lock, signing, bundle import, and both workspace-create entries. New tests cover signed, unsigned, revoked-key, no-clock, stale-head, partial-state, and malformed-bundle cases. Tests were not rerun because this reviewer may write only Seal metadata. The separate risk:critical human gate remains required.

data.reason: Full persisted range reviewed. No security blocker found. The risk:critical human gate remains separate.
Risk review completed with no finding.
